name: Account Use Policies
summary: Account Use Policies enforce rules like lockout mechanisms and login restrictions to reduce unauthorized access and brute-force attacks.

name: Active Directory Configuration
summary: Secure Active Directory configurations via group policies to control access and minimize lateral movement.

name: Antivirus/Antimalware
summary: Deploy antivirus/antimalware solutions with signature, heuristic, and behavioral analysis to detect and block malicious software across all devices.

name: Application Developer Guidance
summary: Provide developers with secure coding training and tools to prevent vulnerabilities in applications and APIs.

name: Application Isolation and Sandboxing
summary: Run code in isolated environments like sandboxes or containers to contain threats and limit access to sensitive resources.

name: Audit
summary: Audit system activity and configurations to detect anomalies, identify threats, and meet compliance requirements.

name: Behavior Prevention on Endpoint
summary: Use behavioral analysis and machine learning on endpoints to detect and block malicious activities based on process and API behavior.

name: Boot Integrity
summary: Verify boot process integrity using secure boot and hardware-rooted trust to prevent firmware or bootloader tampering.

name: Code Signing
summary: Digitally sign code to verify authenticity and prevent execution of untrusted or tampered software.

name: Credential Access Protection
summary: Protect credentials by restricting access to storage, hardening against dumping, and monitoring for suspicious activity.

name: Data Backup
summary: Maintain secure, isolated backups of critical data to ensure availability during ransomware or other disruptions.

name: Data Loss Prevention
summary: Use DLP strategies and tools to identify and control sensitive data movement and prevent unauthorized exfiltration.

name: Disable or Remove Feature or Program
summary: Remove or disable unnecessary software and features to reduce the attack surface and prevent exploitation.

name: Do Not Mitigate
summary: Some techniques should not be mitigated directly due to risk of increased instability; instead, use detection and monitoring.

name: Encrypt Sensitive Information
summary: Encrypt sensitive data at rest, in transit, and during processing to ensure confidentiality and integrity.

name: Environment Variable Permissions
summary: Restrict environment variable modifications to authorized users and processes to prevent abuse.

name: Execution Prevention
summary: Implement application control and script blocking to prevent execution of unauthorized or malicious code.

name: Exploit Protection
summary: Deploy exploit protection capabilities to detect and block exploitation attempts and harden systems.

name: Filter Network Traffic
summary: Filter network traffic using firewalls and protocol-based rules to limit adversary movement and data exfiltration.

name: Limit Access to Resource Over Network
summary: Restrict network resource access to authorized users and systems using gateways and zero-trust models.

name: Limit Hardware Installation
summary: Enforce hardware usage policies and technical controls to prevent unauthorized device installation.

name: Limit Software Installation
summary: Use allowlists and endpoint management to prevent installation of unauthorized software.

name: Multi-factor Authentication
summary: MFA requires at least two verification factors to enhance access security.

name: Network Intrusion Prevention
summary: Use intrusion detection signatures to block malicious traffic at network boundaries.

name: Network Segmentation
summary: Divide networks into isolated segments to limit lateral movement and protect critical assets.

name: Operating System Configuration
summary: Harden OS configurations to reduce vulnerabilities and limit attack surface.

name: Out-of-Band Communications Channel
summary: Use secure out-of-band communication channels for critical communications during incidents to avoid compromised primary networks.

name: Password Policies
summary: Enforce strong password policies including complexity, rotation, and no reuse to reduce unauthorized access.

name: Pre-compromise
summary: Implement proactive measures to reduce attack surface and hinder adversary reconnaissance and resource development.

name: Privileged Account Management
summary: Securely manage privileged accounts via restricted access, limited permissions, monitoring, and auditing.

name: Privileged Process Integrity
summary: Protect highly privileged processes from tampering and injection to prevent privilege escalation.

name: Remote Data Storage
summary: Store critical data like logs off-host to protect against unauthorized access and tampering.

name: Restrict File and Directory Permissions
summary: Set file system access controls to limit who can read, write, or execute files.

name: Restrict Library Loading
summary: Ensure only trusted libraries are loaded to prevent DLL injection and hijacking attacks.

name: Restrict Registry Permissions
summary: Configure registry permissions to prevent unauthorized modifications used for persistence or privilege escalation.

name: Restrict Web-Based Content
summary: Enforce URL filtering and download restrictions to block malicious web content and phishing.

name: Software Configuration
summary: Apply security-focused settings to software to reduce attack surface and protect data.

name: SSL/TLS Inspection
summary: Decrypt and inspect SSL/TLS traffic to detect malicious activity hidden in encrypted channels.

name: Threat Intelligence Program
summary: Establish a threat intelligence program to proactively identify and act on cyber threats using internal and external data.

name: Update Software
summary: Apply software patches and updates to protect against known vulnerabilities.

name: User Account Control
summary: Configure UAC to prompt for elevation and prevent unauthorized system changes.

name: User Account Management
summary: Manage user account lifecycle and privileges to limit unauthorized access and reduce attack surface.

name: User Training
summary: Train users to recognize and report phishing and social engineering threats.

name: Vulnerability Scanning
summary: Perform vulnerability scans to identify and prioritize remediation of security weaknesses.
